answer_1.quote: Pre-trained language models (PLMs) with vast training corpora such as web texts or textbooks have shown remarkable abilities in diverse natural language processing (NLP) tasks.

answer_2.quote: In evaluation, fine-tuning Phi-2 (2.7B), Llama-2 (7B), and Mistral (7B) with ORPO results in higher win rates in AlpacaEval 2.0

answer_3.quote: Using GPT-4 as an evaluator in AlpacaEval 1.0, we assess if the trained model can be preferred over the responses generated from text-davinci-003. For AlpacaEval 2.0, we used GPT-4-turbo as an evaluator following the default setting. We assess if the generated responses are favored over those generated from GPT-4. Finally, using GPT-4 as an evaluator in MT-Bench, we check if the models can follow the instructions with hard answers in a multi-turn conversation.
